performance.driver: Revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased $484.0 million, or 8.1%, from the prior year comparable period. The increase in revenue was driven by organic revenue growth of 5.7%, primarily in our Climate & Sustainability Technologies and Clean Energy & Fueling segments, acquisition-related growth of 1.2% primarily in our Pumps & Process Solutions segment, and a favorable impact from foreign currency translation of 1.2%.

Net sales of $1,183.7 million in the third quarter of 2026 represented a decrease of $7.1 million, or 0.6%, from 2025 levels, reflecting a $33.1 million, or 2.8%, organic decline, partially offset by $25.6 million of acquisition-related sales and $0.4 million of favorable foreign currency translation.
Net sales of $1,210.6 million for the first nine months of 2026 increased 7.9% compared to the same period last year led by higher Commercial Aerospace sales.
Revenue was in line with prior year The 1% increase in global revenue reflects growth of 3% in MA, partially offset by a decline of 1% in MIS.

Revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased by $18.0 million to $66.3 million from $48.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, which is primarily attributed to an increase in the number of our operating leases.

performance.driver: Net sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, for North America Automotive were $7.4 billion, an increase of $247 million, or 3.4%, from 2025. The increase is primarily attributable to a 2.2% increase in comparable sales and a 1.3% increase from acquisitions.
Operating Income Current Quarter Third quarter 2026 operating income decreased $15 million, or 3 percent, primarily due to a lower operating margin rate, partially offset by higher sales.
Net Sales, Cost of Sales and Gross Profit Net sales increased by $362.7 million, or 26.5%, in 2026 compared to the prior year, primarily driven by strong growth for our Integrated Memory segment.

Net sales increased $2.6 billion organically in the quarter ended September 30, 2026, primarily due to higher organic net sales of $1.0 billion at Raytheon, $0.9 billion at Collins, and $0.8 billion at Pratt & Whitney.
